_about: THE WHY LINE (FIGHT SCREEN 11/14/26; VAMILY rule 449(a), ask row 617; Paolo 11/14: 'It doesn't explain why people are trying to attack you... I want there to be a sentence, just one sentence... why the fuck the enemies are attacking you or why the fuck the animals are attacking you'). Every fight opens with ONE sentence that says why this group is on him, true to what started it. This file is the whole table and a modder may edit it: HOW a fight began (the word the map's door hands over), WHO they are (the kinds standing on the board), and the RULES that join the two, first match wins. 'them' lines are said by their leader's face; 'ours' lines by one of his own men (a beast, a ghost and a machine do not talk). {boss} becomes ', boss' when a man of his says it and nothing when he is alone and says it himself. Every line is one plain English sentence, an attempt, draft:true. Read by slices/bohemia_fight_why.js and shown by slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html; held by gates/the_why_line_gate.js (no fight starts without a true reason).
source: records/BOHEMIA_DYNASTY_WHY_SO_MANY_FIGHT_YOU_11_6_26.md (the seven reasons, each on its real floor); records/target/bb/bohemia_enemies.json (every faction's and every beast's lesson and habitat); records/target/bb/factions.json (each faction's want and its cold line); slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html and its helpers (the 'why' every hand-over carries)
known_why: engine/bohemia_renown.js bands: 1,800 is 'A NAME IN THE VALLEY', the first band that says he has a name; under it nobody comes for a name he does not have (DYNASTY s2.3 HE IS KNOWN). TUNING may move it.
who_why: a kind is in the group that lists it under kinds (a name, or a 'prefix_*'), else the group that lists one of its factions (read off the fight's own tables: a new kind a lane adds to a known faction's mix is in that faction's group with no edit here), else, for a man nobody names, the group kept for that kind of fight (when: 'boss' or 'pit'); a kind of a brand new faction is nobody until its faction is listed, and the gate says so
leaders_why: who speaks for a group of men: the boss when the fight has one, else the first man whose kind carries one of these words, else their toughest man

work.means: a job he took: somebody paid him to come
work.from: DYNASTY s2.1 MOST FIGHTS ARE WORK

cart.means: he is worth robbing: batteries, guns and food on a cart
cart.from: DYNASTY s2.2 HE IS WORTH ROBBING; batteries are the money (9/4)

name.means: his name: a crew that beats a known crew takes its name, and a known name has a price
name.from: DYNASTY s2.3 HE IS KNOWN; rule 449(a) 'the bounty on his name'

ground.means: whose ground he is standing on: this faction holds this kind of ground
ground.from: bohemia_enemies.json road.holds; rule 449(a) 'whose ground he stands on'

followed.means: they tracked him across the map and caught him
followed.from: the map's hunt (a party COMING FOR YOU)

cornered.means: he went after them: they fight because he left them no way out
cornered.from: the map's chase (his second tap on a party)

his_place.means: they came to his place for what he keeps there
his_place.from: the map's raid on his base

their_home.means: he came to take their place: they are defending their home
their_home.from: the map's taking of a base

purse.means: the pit: the Mob pays whoever is left standing and the crowd paid to watch

came_for_him.means: he came for the boss, in the boss's own place

order.means: a boss's order: stop whoever walks in
order.from: rule 449(a) 'a boss's order'; slices/bohemia_bosses.js (his machines, his riggers)

trespass.means: he walked into their place on his own business

fire.means: they found his camp by its fire

hunger.means: hunger: nothing left to eat but him
hunger.from: rule 389 THE BEAST MATH; the bestiary's lessons

food.means: the food in his cart: they smell it
food.from: rule 449(a) 'the meat in his cart'; engine/bohemia_origin_start.js (the wagon's FOOD)

den.means: a nest, a den, a herd: he came too close to where they live

unknown.means: nobody in act one knows why the dead get up, and the line says so

job.means: a job from a board or a place: he took pay to come here

hunted.means: a party that was coming for him caught him on the map

road.means: something on the road stopped his company

chase.means: he went after a party he saw on the map

raid.means: a crew came to the gate of his own place

take.means: he came to the gate of somebody else's place to take it

boss.means: he walked up to a boss

guard.means: a boss's guards on the boss's ground

place.means: he picked the fight inside one of the valley's places

camp.means: a crew found him at camp

met.means: nothing was handed over (the fight page opened on its own): who they are is all there is to go on

boss_crews.name: a boss and the men he keeps
